title: 最大升序子数组和
summary: 求严格升序连续子数组的最大元素和。
insight: 扫描维护当前严格升序段的和；当前值大于前一值则延长，否则从当前值重新开始。
pitfalls: 必须严格递增，相等会断开
所有数为正所以完整升序段和最大

solutions.title: 升序段和扫描
solutions.idea: 在线累计当前严格升序连续段。
steps: i 从一：nums[i]>nums[i-1] 时 current+=nums[i]，否则 current=nums[i]

code.java: class Solution { public int maxAscendingSum(int[] nums){int current=nums[0],answer=current;for(int i=1;i<nums.length;i++){current=nums[i]>nums[i-1]?current+nums[i]:nums[i];answer=Math.max(answer,current);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxAscendingSum(nums:IntArray):Int{var current=nums[0];var answer=current;for(i in 1 until nums.size){current=if(nums[i]>nums[i-1])current+nums[i] else nums[i];answer=maxOf(answer,current)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxAscendingSum(vector<int>& nums){int current=nums[0],answer=current;for(int i=1;i<(int)nums.size();++i){current=nums[i]>nums[i-1]?current+nums[i]:nums[i];answer=max(answer,current);}return answer;} };
